title: Recurrence Schema
description: Approximate yearly recurrence pattern of a recurring event

frequency.description: How often the event is held

type.description: Calendar system or pattern anchoring the recurrence

typicalDurationDays.description: Typical length of the event in days, if known

note.description: Free-text clarification of the recurrence (e.g. 'last two weeks of July', 'dates vary by edition')

url.description: Link supporting the schedule information; can be anything (program, press release, announcement...)

title.description: Short label for the link (e.g. 'Official program', 'Press release')

urls.description: Links documenting when the event takes place (programs, press releases, announcements...)

months.description: Gregorian month number(s), 1-12, in which the event usually takes place

part.description: Approximate part of the month (or of the month range) when the event happens

hijriMonth.description: Hijri month number, 1 (Muharram) to 12 (Dhu al-Hijjah). Gregorian dates drift ~11 days earlier each year

hijriDay.description: Hijri day of month anchoring the event, if it is tied to a specific day

observance.description: Named Islamic observance the event is attached to, if any

season.description: Season in which the event usually takes place
